primary_source_claims.claim: --retry count is in addition to the initial transfer; versioned default transient list, backoff, and Retry-After behavior
--max-time is per transfer and resets; retry-max-time does not stop an already-started attempt
HTTP 400+ can be made a curl failure while retaining body
--retry-all-errors is broader and carries duplicate data risk
write-out can expose retries and response code

proposed_acceptance_checks: 503, 503, 503, 200 sequence with Retry-After; verify at most four total attempts and publication only after valid 200.
404 and repeated 503 cases; verify no retry for 404, four-attempt cap for transient 503, failure diagnostics and no publication.
Cancel during a retry delay; verify child stops, cancellation is recorded and no empty or partial catalog is published.
